rv.q: With Beyreis at the helm and a committed ensemble bringing Silverman’s adaptation to life, Idle Muse creates a performance which is funny, unsettling, and deeply human.
Silverman’s Jacobean reworking is hilarious, dark, and exhilarating.
I highly recommend Idle Muse's WITCH.
Now it’s back in a nifty production with Idle Muse Theatre Company.
Idle Muse's selection of this play at this time in history underscores our need to hope that things can and will get better.
This is a generous show packed with many pleasures, challenging ideas, great storytelling, wit and humor, and solid acting and production.

cn.t: Silverman's clever, darkly humorous update of a Jacobean witch tale wins praise for its contemporary relevance and feminist firepower. Critics laud the provocative storytelling and solid performances, finding it witty, timely, and thematically rich.
